title: Deploying liquid intelligence in cancer: Finding answers in our blood
title_zh: 在癌症中部署液态智能：在血液中寻找答案
abstract: Liquid biopsies are one of the few noninvasive procedures for probing disease at the molecular level. They represent a scalable solution to cancer detection and monitoring by capturing tumor-derived signals from circulating biomolecules such as proteins, DNA, RNA, and metabolites. However, these signals are often sparse, heterogeneous, and shaped by genetics, demographics, and comorbidities. Recent advances in artificial intelligence, especially with multimodal foundation models, have proven capable of extracting signals from noisy, high-dimensional data. Pretraining on large cohorts and integrating complementary modalities may improve sensitivity for tumor signals in blood, though significant clinical and infrastructural barriers remain. This review synthesizes advances in liquid biopsy technologies and artificial intelligence and examines how their convergence can enable enhanced cancer monitoring.
abstract_zh: 液态活检是少数能够在分子层面探测疾病的非侵入性程序之一。通过捕获循环生物分子（如蛋白质、DNA、RNA 和代谢物）中的肿瘤源信号，它代表了一种可扩展的癌症检测和监测方案。然而，这些信号通常稀疏且异质，并受遗传、人口学因素和合并症的影响。人工智能（尤其是多模态基础模型）的最新进展已被证明能够从噪声高维数据中提取信号。在大规模队列上预训练并整合互补模态可能提高对血液中肿瘤信号的敏感性，尽管重大的临床和基础设施障碍仍然存在。本综述综合了液态活检技术和人工智能的进展，并考察了二者的融合如何实现增强的癌症监测。
